entries.title: I Timothy 2:1
segments: ¶I exhort therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings be made for all men;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:2
segments: for kings and all that are in dignity, that we may lead a quiet and tranquil life in all piety and gravity;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:3
segments: for this is good and acceptable before our Saviour God,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:4
segments: who desires that all men should be saved and come to [the] knowledge of [the] truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:5
segments: For God is one, and [the] mediator of God and men one, [the] man Christ Jesus,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:6
segments: who gave himself a ransom for all, the testimony [to be rendered] in its own times;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:7
segments: to which *I* have been appointed a herald and apostle, (I speak [the] truth, I do not lie,) a teacher of [the] nations in faith and truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:8
segments: I will therefore that the men pray in every place, lifting up pious hands, without wrath or reasoning.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:9
segments: ¶In like manner also that the women in decent deportment and dress adorn themselves with modesty and discretion, not with plaited [hair] and gold, or pearls, or costly clothing,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:10
segments: but, what becomes women making profession of the fear of God, by good works.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:11
segments: Let a woman learn in quietness in all subjection;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:12
segments: but I do not suffer a woman to teach nor to exercise authority over man, but to be in quietness;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:13
segments: for Adam was formed first, then Eve:

entries.title: I Timothy 2:14
segments: and Adam was not deceived; but the woman, having been deceived, was in transgression.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:15
segments: But she shall be preserved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and love and holiness with discretion.
